name: Is a vapor barrier necessary under basement flooring?

mainEntity.name: Is a vapor barrier necessary under basement flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: A vapor barrier is highly recommended, and often necessary, under most types of basement flooring, especially when installing over a concrete slab. Concrete is porous and can allow moisture to wick up from the ground, contributing to humidity and potential mold growth. A vapor barrier, typically a polyethylene sheet or a liquid membrane, creates a protective layer that blocks this moisture, safeguarding your flooring material from damage and extending its lifespan. Skipping this step can lead to significant issues over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a vapor barrier is usually necessary under basement flooring, particularly over concrete, to block moisture wicking and prevent damage to the flooring material.
